signIn.title: Client sign in
signIn.heading: Client sign in
signIn.intro: For ScoutIQ clients. Sign in with the email address we have on file for you.
signIn.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to that address. Open it on this device.
signIn.inAppBrowser: Google sign-in does not work inside this app's own browser. Open this page in Safari or Chrome to sign in.
signIn.error: Sign-in did not finish. Please try again.

notLinked.heading: This account is not linked to a client yet
notLinked.body: If you expected to see your project here, email us and we will sort it out.

chooser.heading: Choose a client
chooser.adminNote: You are signed in as admin. Each client's area looks just as it does to them, and it is read only.

overview.goalsNote: These dates are goals, not guarantees.
overview.agreementDraft: [Agreement draft] sent for your review on {date}. Not signed yet.

costs.strip: Maintenance and support are free through the {season} season.

maintenance.heading: Maintenance and support
maintenance.terms: Free through the {free} season. From {from}, {rate} per tournament, billed once a year before the season. The rate is locked through {locked}. A tournament counts once, however many days it runs.
maintenance.example: A year like {season} would be {count} x {rate} = {total}.

appTools.heading: App development tools and accounts
appTools.share: {amount} a year: your share of the ScoutIQ Apple developer account your app is listed under.
appTools.buildTime: Plus Mac build time at {hourly} an hour, billed by the minute for the minutes actually used.
appTools.checkInNote: We check with you before build time passes {amount} in a year.

costs.providersNote: Each provider bills you directly, at cost. ScoutIQ adds nothing.
costs.scrollHint: Swipe or scroll sideways to see the whole table.

documents.notOnline: Not available online yet. [Email us] for a copy.
documents.fileError: This document could not be opened. Please try again, or [email us] for a copy.
documents.downloadedInstead: The document downloaded instead of opening here. You can close this tab.

account.lede: Keep these up to date so invoices reach the right person.
account.appToolsInvoice: When do you want the app tools invoice?
account.payBy: How do you prefer to pay?
account.saveError: That did not save. Please check your connection and try again.
account.readOnly: Read only. Only the client can change these details.
account.noCardNumbers: Please leave out card and bank numbers. We never need them here.
account.phoneFormat: Use only digits, spaces and + ( ) . - in the phone number.
account.emailFormat: Enter a whole email address, like name@example.com.
account.phoneDigits: Enter the whole phone number, with the area code.
account.zipFormat: Enter a 5 digit ZIP code, like 54901.
account.noteNeeded: Please tell us a little more.

finish.heading: Finish setting up your account
finish.lede: We need these so your invoices reach the right person and place. It takes about a minute.
